answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through ambient acoustic verification. Each node records real-time soundscapes from an outdoor terrace, cross-referencing transient spikes such as a calling raven or raindrops hitting a lotus leaf. Measuring time-difference-of-arrival across microphones binds identity to space, forcing an attacker to deploy separate physical sensors per identity. However, high wind noise can mask acoustic transients, causing false rejections of honest nodes.
